translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Jesús Gerasagin tule-nia-ichejul-nikad-nudajad
Tenal Jesús aga e-chapinganbak yabli mata-opakal opasmal, neg-kwebur-Gerasa-tikalbal.
Tegin Jesús ul-akar aktesgu, tule-nia-nikad panna uan-akar Jesús-takcha. Tegin tule-nia-nikad Jesúszhe al.
Tenal we tuledin kusgu uanbal megda tegin tulemal kwen unniguszhulmal we tule-edingal ezha-tubgin-pakal.
Tenal tulemal melugus ezha-tubgin e-mali, e-chakwa edinmalan, tenal tule-nia-nikad yabli ezha-tub idiris. Tenal tule-pid pal nikchul, we tulegin nakwegal.
Tenal tule-nia-nikad mutik-ibgin uanbal tegin yalaganbal kolmakalda. Tegin we tule aga tukin akwagin aga sakialdabal.
Tegin tule-nia-nikad Jesúszhe abarmanoni tegin Jesús-abir chimtinoni.
Tegin tule-nia-nikad pinnajul Jesúsga chogal: —¿Ibiga pe ankin yoledani-wede? Jesús, pedin Pab-Pul-Tummad-e-Machi. Imi an pei pe Pab-wagin napírra anka chogo: pedin, pe chabzhul an-imakojulye.
Imi teun Jesús pato niaga chogzhado: “Pedin we tule-akar noenab.”
Tenal Jesús niaje ekichial: —¿Igi pe nugdé? Tegin nia Jesúsga chogal: —Antin nug: “Ichejulid.” Tenal anmal-niamal íchejul tulegin pukwadbal weob nugdo.
Tegin nia kannan-kannan Jesúszhe wilenaigual, melle we neg-akar emal-palmigal.
Imi teun-takalgu chinmal-íchejul yal-abal mas mabukmal.
Tegin niamal Jesúszhe wilegalmal chogalmal: —Pe chinzhe anmal-wis-palmioma, anmal chingin ukpogal.

Tegin Jesús niaga igal-ukchajun chingin ukpogal. Tegin niamal tulegin-maid-akar nodgu, ilgwen chingin ukpotapmalzhun. Tenal chin-milibo-pukwad arpak koelegalmalgu, ilgwen pulal turmadmal. Tegin chinmal yal-urchikal-kwichidgin mataje ilgwen pél apatismal. Tegin chinmal pél tigin ogangusmalzhun.

Al tulemal-chin-takpukmalad abarmadmal, igalbal-tule-mamimaladga tegin tule-neg-kweburginmaladga choge-nad. Tenal tulemal wisgusmalgu tule-nia-nika-nad nugus tegin chinmal ogangusmal, Jesús-chiidzhe almal takegal igi kus.
Tegin tulemal Jesúszhe nonimalgu, taknoni, tule-nia-nika-nad Jesús-nabal mol-yowi nued chii, we tule pato koelegal-chul. Al tulemal Jesúsgin-kwakialmalzhun.
Tegin tulemal-takchamalad, tule-nonimaladga pél palchogzhajun, immal igi kujad; tule-nia-nika-nad igi nugus, tegin chinmalgin igi kusbalid.
Tegin tulemal Jesúszhe wilegalmal Jesús kannan emal-neg-akar negal.
Tegin Jesús ulgin nakwisgu kannan negal, tule-nia-nika-nad Jesúszhe wilenaigualmo Jesúsbak mes negal.
Tenal Jesús tule-nugujadga chogal: —Imi pedin keg anpak neel, tenal pe kannan aga negzhe neenab, pe-kwenamaladga pél pe palchoggal, Pab igi pe-nudas, tegin Pab igi wilejakwa pe-taknonibal.
Tegin tule-nugujad Decápoliszhe ilgwen nadzhun. Tegin tule-nugujad Decápoliszhe omosgu, tulemalga pél palchogdi-kual, Jesús e-nudas. Al tulemal-neg-kweburginmalad weob pakal pesmal.
Jesús Jairo-chiskwa-purkwijad-otulojad; tegin ome-yeed-nudasbalid
Tegin Jesús mata-opakal-akar ulgin nonigu, mata-kakagin pes, tenal tulemal-íchejul Jesúszhe nonimal.
Tegin tule-walgwen Jesús-chiidzhe nonigu, Jesús-abir chimtinoni. Tenal we tuledin nug Jairo. Tenal we Jairodin Judio-ormaked-neg-e-tummad-walgwen.
Tenal Jairo Jesúszhe wilegal chogal: —An-chiskwa iche-napi purkwedani-mai. Al an pei, pe anpak nao, chunkalgin an-chiskwa-ebugoedgin an-chiskwa-nudagal, melle purkwegal.
Tegin Jesús tarbak ilgwen nadzhun. Tenal tulemal-íchejul Jesúsbak pulal-pulal nadmalmo, Jesúsgin pél yolenanimal.
Imi teun tulemal-irmamamimalad-abalgin, ome-walgwen natapmo. Tenal we omedin pirkaambe-kakabogus, e-purpa-takedbak a-imadii.
Tenal we ome pinche ina-tulganzhe nunmaked abingedi-kus, tenal we ome pinche pél aga mani misbal, tenal yabli kwen nuguszhul-kus. Tenal we omega pul-kigma poni pulgu-natap.

Tegin ome-yeed itosgu tulemal-Jesúsgin-chunma, tulemal-impabal Jesúszhe noni. Tenal ome aga tukin pinzhas: “Imi an Jesús-mol-tuku wis ebujal, antin nuguo.” Tegin ome yankalbal-akar Jesús-mol-tuku ebuszhun.
Tegidgin omega e-poni ilgwen akus-nad. Tegin ome aga mag itos ede nugus.
Tegidgin Jesús mag itosmo, ede e-kannalegedbal tule-walgwen-nudas. Tegin Jesús kannan chorzhik akpiridgu, tulemalzhe ekichial: —¿Toa an-mol-tuku ebusdé?
Tegin e-chapingan Jesúsga chogalmal: —¿Igi pe wisguo, toa-tule pe-mol-tuku ebus? ¿Pe takchulzhí, tulemal-íchejul pegin walmananimal?
Tenal Jesús yabli amigwisgual toa-tule e-mol-tuku ebus.
Tenal ome mag itos, ede nugus. Al ome kwakijadbal, tutumakal Jesús-abir chimtinoni. Tegin ome Jesúsga pél palchogalzhun ede igi kudiid.
Tegin Jesús omega chogalzhun: —Puna, pe ulubgin ankin penzhul-kunonikidbal pe nugus. Imidin pe akalzhul negzhe nao; pe poni ilgwen pelgus.

Tegin Jesús ampa ome-nugujadbak chunma-kwichidgin, tulemal Jairo-neg-akar nonimal. Tegin tule-nonimalad Jairoga chogalmal: —Jairo, pe-chiskwa pato purkwis. Pe melle Tule-oturdakedzhe pal wilego, pebak negzhe negal.
Tenal Jesús tule-Jairoga-chognonikid itosgu, Jairoga chogal: —Pe melle akal-itogo, unnila ankinbi pe ibzhao.
Tegin Jesús chogalbal: —An peichul tule-pimalad anmalbak nemo. An pei, tule-anpak-nemaloed unnila Pedro, Jacobo, tegin e-urpa-Juan, amal-naoed-walapá.
Tegin Jesús Jairo-negzhe nonimalgu, oimabuk tulemal-taknonimal, tenal tulemal kolmakal-kolmakal ponanimal.
Tegin Jesús neg-yabal tognonigu, tule-ponanimaladga chogal: —¿Ibiga pe ponanimal, pe oimananimal-wede? We puna kwen purkwiszhul, pinche kabmai.
Tenal tulemal Jesúsga allialmal chogalmal: —Pinche pe chunmama. Tegin Jesús magarbal pel-kwapa tulemal-onisgu, e-pakamalad-walapágwadbak, tegin puna-e-pab, e-nan, puna-maidzhe togzhamal.
Tegin Jesús chunkalbal puna-kasgu, e-kakabal punaga chogal: —“Talita, cum.” Wedin chogledo: “Puna, an pega chog; kwisgu.”
Tegidgin puna kwisgudgu, ilgwen nanal. Tenal puna pirkaambe-kakabog nika. Tenal tule-takpukmalad weob pakal pesmalzhun.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapingan-walapágwadga tegin puna-nanganga chogal: —Pe melle tule-pimaladga pe palchogo imis pél immal kujad. Tegin pe masgin puna-okunno. Tegin Jesús nadzhun.
